name: ReCons Timesheet
author: buzzer222

sections.description:
• Time clock with rounding interval (1, 6 or 15 minutes). It keeps running on the server, even when the browser is closed.
  • Projects with client, hourly rate and currency, hour budget (warning at 80 % / 100 %), purchase order number, default location, color and archive.
  • Add or edit time entries: From/To with break or a duration (1:30 or 1.5), billable or internal, billed.
  • Key figures: hours of the week and month, revenue of the month, unbilled amount.
  • Stacked chart of the last 8 calendar weeks.
  • Journal with filters by period, project and status.
  • CSV export (Excel compatible) and timesheet as print view with signature lines – save it as PDF from the print dialog.
  • CSV import with check before saving: German or English column headers, projects matched by name or created, existing entries skipped.
  • Access per user: administrators grant it on the user profile; the users list shows who has access.
  • Data separated by user ID: every user only sees their own projects and time entries, also on shared pages with the shortcode.
  • Uses the colors of your site: background, text and button or link color of the active theme; in the admin area the user’s admin color scheme. Light and dark themes are detected.
  • No external services, no external fonts.
  • Privacy: export and erasure via Tools → Export/Erase Personal Data; suggested text for the privacy policy.
  • Translation-ready (English source texts); translations are provided through translate.wordpress.org.

Uninstall

Time tracking data is relevant for invoicing and is kept when the plugin is deleted. To remove everything, add the following to wp-config.php before deleting the plugin:
define( ‘FRTS_REMOVE_ALL_DATA’, true );
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Open the menu item “Timesheet”.
  3. Optional: add the shortcode [recons_timesheet] to a page (only visible to logged-in users with access). Attribute theme="site|light|dark|auto", default site (colors of your theme); light, dark and auto use the plugin’s own palette.
sections.faq:
Who can use the timesheet?

Logged-in users with the capability frts_use_timesheet. Administrators receive it on activation. Grant it to further users under Users → Edit user → Timesheet → Access; the column “Timesheet” in the users list shows who has access. Whole roles can be granted with a role editor; another capability can be set with the filter frts_capability.

Can several users share one page with the shortcode?

Yes. Everyone sees only their own projects, time entries, time clock and settings; data is stored with the WordPress user ID and every request is limited to it. Visitors who are not logged in see a login link, users without access a short notice.

Which colors are used?

By default the colors of your site: the timesheet measures the background, text color and the button color (or, if the theme has no colored buttons, the link color) of the page it is shown on and derives all surfaces and lines from them. This works with block themes and classic themes. In the admin area it follows the admin color scheme of the user. Status colors (open, billed, running clock) and project colors stay fixed so they remain legible. To use the plugin’s own palette instead, set theme="light", "dark" or "auto" on the shortcode, or use the filter frts_admin_theme for the admin page.

Which currencies are supported?

Each project has its own currency, chosen when the project is created or edited (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, CAD, AUD, JPY, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN, CZK, HUF, RON). Amounts are shown in the project’s currency; totals across projects are listed per currency and never converted. The default for new projects is the currency of the most recently created project, otherwise EUR. Change the default with the filter frts_currency and the list with the filter frts_currencies (ISO 4217 codes).

Which CSV files can be imported?

Files with a header row and at least the columns Date, Project and Duration (h) – or From and To instead of the duration. Separator semicolon, comma or tab; dates as DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD; decimal comma or point. Further recognized columns: Client, Break (min), Activity, Location, Billable, Rate, Currency (ISO code or €, $, £), Billed. Projects created by the import take rate and currency from the file. German column names (Datum, Projekt, Dauer (h) …) are recognized as well.

screenshots.caption: Overview in the admin area: running time clock, key figures, hours per calendar week, projects and time entries.
Add time with From/To and break, or as a duration; the result is calculated as you type.
Project settings: client, hourly rate, currency, hour budget and purchase order.
Printable timesheet with signature lines for contractor and client – save it as PDF from the print dialog.
CSV import with a check before saving: new entries, duplicates and rows with errors are listed.
On a front-end page via shortcode, the timesheet uses the colors of your theme.
